answer_2.quote: We evaluate annotation quality using intersection-over-union (IoU) with manually annotated spans, achieving an IoU of 69%, indicating substantial agreement (IoU > 50% is considered indicative of good agreement by DeYoung et al. ( )).

answer_4.quote: We manually assigned binary labels (acceptable/unacceptable) to 30 explanations per model.
answer_4.guideline: The prompts were structured to include natural language rationales, not intended as a supervision signal, but as an evaluation tool to check how well a given model interprets the data at hand.
